quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported WH-Question
quests.directSpeech: Sofia asked, "What time does the train leave?"
quests.reportedSpeech: Sofia asked what time the train left.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Does leave' becomes 'left'; the auxiliary disappears and the question word 'what time' stays at the front.
quests.nativeTip: Wh-questions drop 'do/does/did' and use statement word order after the question word.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Sofia asked, "What time does the train leave?"" ➔ "Sofia asked what time the train left."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported WH-Question
quests.directSpeech: The waiter asked, "What would you like to order?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The waiter asked what I would like to order.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Would' stays the same, but inversion is removed and 'you' becomes 'I'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Would' doesn't need to change — fix the word order and the pronoun instead.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The waiter asked, "What would you like to order?"" ➔ "The waiter asked what I would like to order."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Marcus asked, "What are you doing this weekend?"
quests.reportedSpeech: Marcus asked what I was doing that weekend.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Are doing' becomes 'was doing', 'you' becomes 'I', and 'this weekend' becomes 'that weekend'.
quests.nativeTip: Combine the continuous backshift, the pronoun, and the time-word change.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Marcus asked, "What are you doing this weekend?"" ➔ "Marcus asked what I was doing that weekend."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported WH-Question
quests.directSpeech: The tourist asked, "Where is the nearest pharmacy?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The tourist asked where the nearest pharmacy was.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Is' backshifts to 'was', and the question word 'where' is followed by normal statement order.
quests.nativeTip: Backshift the verb 'to be' and put the subject before it, as in a normal statement.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The tourist asked, "Where is the nearest pharmacy?"" ➔ "The tourist asked where the nearest pharmacy was."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported WH-Question
quests.directSpeech: Elena asked, "Where did you park the car?"
quests.reportedSpeech: Elena asked where I had parked the car.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Did park' becomes 'had parked', and 'you' becomes 'I'.
quests.nativeTip: A finished past action reported later usually backshifts one more step.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Elena asked, "Where did you park the car?"" ➔ "Elena asked where I had parked the car."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported WH-Question
quests.directSpeech: The manager asked, "Where will the meeting be held?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The manager asked where the meeting would be held.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Will' becomes 'would', and normal statement order follows 'where'.
quests.nativeTip: Backshift the modal, then place the subject before the verb.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The manager asked, "Where will the meeting be held?"" ➔ "The manager asked where the meeting would be held."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported WH-Question
quests.directSpeech: Hassan asked, "When does the store open?"
quests.reportedSpeech: Hassan asked when the store opened.

quests.nativeTip: Remove the auxiliary 'does' completely and backshift the main verb instead.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Hassan asked, "When does the store open?"" ➔ "Hassan asked when the store opened."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported WH-Question

quests.nativeTip: This past action moves one more step back, into the past perfect.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Grace asked, "When did you arrive?"" ➔ "Grace asked when I had arrived."

quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The client asked, "When can we expect a reply?"" ➔ "The client asked when they could expect a reply."

quests.nativeTip: Backshift the verb, then fix the pronoun and the word order.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The teacher asked, "Why are you late?"" ➔ "The teacher asked why I was late."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech

quests.ruleExplanation: 'Didn't call' becomes 'hadn't called', 'you' becomes 'I', and 'me' becomes 'her'.
quests.nativeTip: Three items change: the negative past tense, the subject pronoun, and the object pronoun.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Isabella asked, "Why didn't you call me?"" ➔ "Isabella asked why I hadn't called her."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported WH-Question

changesList: question word order → statement word order

quests.nativeTip: Remove the auxiliary and update the demonstrative pronoun.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The editor asked, "Why does this sentence sound odd?"" ➔ "The editor asked why that sentence sounded odd."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported WH-Question
quests.directSpeech: The detective asked, "Who broke this window?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The detective asked who had broken that window.
quests.ruleExplanation: Because 'who' is the subject, word order doesn't change, but 'broke' backshifts to 'had broken', and 'this' becomes 'that'.
quests.nativeTip: Since 'who' is already the subject, word order stays the same — only the verb and the demonstrative change.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The detective asked, "Who broke this window?"" ➔ "The detective asked who had broken that window."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported WH-Question
quests.directSpeech: Diego asked, "Who is calling at this hour?"
quests.reportedSpeech: Diego asked who was calling at that hour.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Is calling' backshifts to 'was calling', and 'this' becomes 'that'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Who' as the subject means no inversion to fix — just backshift the verb and the demonstrative.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Diego asked, "Who is calling at this hour?"" ➔ "Diego asked who was calling at that hour."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported WH-Question
quests.directSpeech: The coach asked, "Who wants to play first?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The coach asked who wanted to play first.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Wants' backshifts to 'wanted'; no word-order change is needed because 'who' is the subject.
quests.nativeTip: This is a simple one-step backshift with no word-order change needed.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The coach asked, "Who wants to play first?"" ➔ "The coach asked who wanted to play first."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported WH-Question

quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The customer asked, "Which color do you recommend?"" ➔ "The customer asked which color I recommended."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported WH-Question

quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The examiner asked, "Which answer is correct?"" ➔ "The examiner asked which answer was correct."

quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The agent asked, "Which flight will you take?"" ➔ "The agent asked which flight I would take."

quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The stranger asked, "How do I get to the museum?"" ➔ "The stranger asked how he got to the museum."

quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The instructor asked, "How did you solve this problem?"" ➔ "The instructor asked how I had solved that problem."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech

quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The parent asked, "How do you feel today?"" ➔ "The parent asked how I felt that day."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported WH-Question
quests.directSpeech: The shopper asked, "How much does this cost?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The shopper asked how much that cost.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Does cost' loses its auxiliary and becomes simply 'cost' (an irregular verb unchanged in the past), and 'this' becomes 'that'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Cost' is an irregular verb that doesn't change form in the past — only the auxiliary disappears.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The shopper asked, "How much does this cost?"" ➔ "The shopper asked how much that cost."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Reported WH-Question
quests.directSpeech: The organizer asked, "How many people are coming?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The organizer asked how many people were coming.

quests.nativeTip: Match the past form of 'to be' to the plural subject.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The organizer asked, "How many people are coming?"" ➔ "The organizer asked how many people were coming."

quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The manager asked, "How much time do we have?"" ➔ "The manager asked how much time they had."

quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The passenger asked, "How long will the delay be?"" ➔ "The passenger asked how long the delay would be."

quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The journalist asked, "Why did the company delay the announcement?"" ➔ "The journalist asked why the company had delayed the announcement."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The host asked, "How many guests will you bring tomorrow?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The host asked how many guests I would bring the next day.

quests.nativeTip: This review question combines the modal, the pronoun, the time word, and the word order.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The host asked, "How many guests will you bring tomorrow?"" ➔ "The host asked how many guests I would bring the next day."
